main_claim: The authors propose Hierarchical MPO-Attention, a tensor network-based compression method for transformer self-attention using a 2-level binary tree MERA structure, claiming reduced computational complexity and provable approximation error bounds.
supporting_subclaims: Hierarchical MPO-Attention reduces computational complexity by a constant factor of 16 compared to standard attention.
The approximation error is bounded by the distance to the optimal rank-chi approximation plus an MPO-specific gap.
The mechanism exhibits local level-wise permutation equivariance.
Empirical performance on associative recall outperforms a random baseline.
